newsitem.title: ISRAEL: PLO confirms it caught West Bank settlers' killers.
newsitem.headline: PLO confirms it caught West Bank settlers' killers.

text.p: The PLO said on Wednesday it had arrested the Palestinian guerrillas who killed a Jewish settler and her 12-year-old son in a West Bank ambush a week ago.

Palestinian Preventative Security Chief Jibril Rajoub, asked to confirm reports that PLO forces had rounded up the gunmen who carried out the drive-by shooting last Wednesday near the self-ruled West Bank town of Ramallah, told Reuters:
"The reports are correct." He declined to elaborate.

Israel had demanded Yasser Arafat's Palestinian Authority crack down on the Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine (PFLP), a radical PLO faction which has claimed responsibility for the killings of Etta Tzur and her son Ephraim of the Ramallah-area settlement of Beit El.

Israeli security sources said two PFLP guerrillas who sprayed the settlers' car with automatic fire were captured soon after the shooting. The driver of the guerrillas' getaway car was seized late on Wednesday along with two weapons, they said.
The sources said Rajoub would meet later on Wednesday with Israel's overall West Bank military commander to formally inform him of the arrests.
Earlier settlers laid the cornerstone of a new settlement in the West Bank in what they said was a response to the killings.
The PLO has been tight-lipped about its investigation of the ambush. But a PFLP leader has said scores of its activists are in Palestinian custody.
